scholarships: M.Sc. with 65% (6.5 CGPA) or first rank. JRF and SRF with HRA and annual contingency; SRF upgrade needs a first-authored paper.
Qualify CSIR NET (June and December) with 55% at M.Sc. (50% for SC/ST/PwD) and enrol for Ph.D. within two years.
Through the NBHM Ph.D. screening test.

UGC; first-year regular PG students under 30.
admission: B.A./B.Sc. and M.A./M.Sc. admissions are now through CUET, conducted by NTA. Applications usually open in February and run for about a month; internal students have a quota.
Selection is on a merit list from CUET marks and department criteria; counselling does not by itself guarantee a seat.
B.Sc. Mathematics eligibility (as listed earlier on this site): UR 60% aggregate and 60% in Mathematics at 10+2; OBC 54%; SC/ST a pass in Mathematics. Always confirm with the current prospectus.
Bring a photo ID, date-of-birth proof, CUET score card, 10+2 mark sheet, category certificate where applicable, and a copy of the online form.
reach: Bolpur (Santiniketan) BHP or Prantik on Eastern Railway. Trains from Howrah/Sealdah and New Jalpaiguri.
Jambuni or Lodge More (Bolpur), Kalisayor More (Sriniketan).
E-rickshaws (toto) drop you near the department.

steps: Apply to the Board of Studies through your supervisor with title, registration number and publications.
Prepare a 30-minute pre-Ph.D. seminar; bring the report format and a list of examiners (three from West Bengal, three from outside).
Write the thesis and synopsis; the supervisor runs the plagiarism check (Drillbit).
Collect the No-Dues certificate signatures in sequence.
Print hard-bound copies (4, or 5 with a co-supervisor) and prepare CDs.
Fill the submission form with Annexures I and II and pay the fee through SBI Collect.
Submit with self-attested documents and take the submission certificate.
Viva-voce after the examiners' reports; then apply for the provisional certificate.
